digest.component_or_area: store event append and atomic ticket directory creation
propositions: Interrupted writes between os.makedirs and first event file create leave empty ticket directories that fsck reports as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH
Creating ticket directory and its first event file must be atomic to prevent debris on interruption, solved by staging in dot-prefixed temporary directory and renaming under write lock
Multiple write paths (single-event and batch creation) share the vulnerable mkdir-then-file window and must all be converted to use atomic staging
Sweep of stale staging directories must clean only writer-owned .tmp-newticket-* paths with provably dead owners, never touch actual ticket directories or store data per bug 043f
Event bytes and ticket directory are published together in one atomic rename operation under the existing write lock, keeping events invisible until rebase guard and concurrency check pass
